# DB Timetable MCP Server
> MCP server that turns Deutsche Bahn OpenBoards data into reliable structured station-board data.

## Core files
- [README.md]: Installation, client configuration and operations.
- [docs/api.md]: MCP tools, resources, parameters and error contract.
- [docs/data-model.md]: Meaning of planned and effective event values.
- [docs/architecture.md]: Components, transports, station index and security model.
- [src/server.ts]: MCP server factory.
- [src/api/boardMapper.ts]: Mapping of OpenBoards responses and board merge.
- [src/stations/stationSearch.ts]: Local station search.

## Key concepts
- Use `findStations` first to get the EVA number.
- Use `getDepartures` or `getArrivals` for one direction, `getStationBoard` for both.
- Use `effective` values for current time and platform; `planned` is the schedule.
- `via` is a selection of stops, never the full route.
- `truncatedTransportTypes` is not empty when entries are missing.
